_doc: Frozen pre-registered ruler-validation anchors for the harness-SOTA benchmark (Plan 09 / 10-PREREGISTRATION-PARAMETERS.md §9 / docs decision 11). Before claiming ANY delta on the τ² substrate, our adapter must reproduce a PUBLISHED leaderboard pass^1 within the pre-registered tolerance (D6). A FAIL blocks the priced run.
_contract: These are the pre-registered reference SPECS (RulerSpec). The Plan-09 pilot reproduction run produces the per-anchor `measured` pass^1 score (currently null). Merge each {spec, measured} into the PreflightRuler[] that `gate`/preflight consumes via --rulers. validateRuler() PASSes iff |measured - published_score| <= tolerance_abs (two-sided: a far-ABOVE reproduction is as suspect as far-below). DO NOT fake `measured` to clear the gate.
_freeze_note: published_score values are fractions in [0,1]; tolerances are N-derived (95% Clopper-Pearson half-width ~ 2*binomial-SE at the task count), NOT the legacy ±1pp placeholder. The old 0.8195 fixture was the borrowed Memori LoCoMo number and was never a τ² reference.

protocol.note: user_simulator MUST equal gpt-5.2 AND the agent MUST run reasoning_effort=high with max_steps=200 (the published gpt-5.x numbers are the *_HIGH variants; the board's gpt-5.2 'none' retail = 75.00 vs 'high' = 81.58). The 2026-06-17 pilot proved that omitting reasoning_effort (tau2's default agent llm_args is temperature-only, dropped for gpt-5.x → reasoning OFF) + max_steps=30 cost ~13pp (docs/12 forensics). A different user-sim, effort, or step budget invalidates the comparison.

anchors.rationale: Exact ceiling-arm (GPT-5.5) on the only domain carrying current-generation published numbers; far-from-ceiling (37.37%) so reproduction exercises the full pass/fail oracle.

spec.source: Sierra τ²-bench leaderboard submission gpt-5-5_sierra_2026-05-05 (results.banking_knowledge.pass_1=37.37; v0.2.1-dev, user_simulator gpt-5.2; arXiv:2506.07982). n=97 -> tolerance = 95% Clopper-Pearson ~ ±10pp (binomial SE ~ 4.9pp at p=0.3737). MUST route via the `gpt-5.5-responses` alias (OpenAI /v1/responses) — gpt-5.5 rejects tools+reasoning on /chat/completions (2026-06-17 pilot).

anchors.measured_run: waggle_ruler_banking_gpt55resp_high_n97k4 (2026-06-18): pass^1 per-task = 34.88% over 97/97 tasks (254 valid trials, 134/388 infra-errored on user-sim RPM throttle but 0/97 tasks fully lost). |Δ|=2.49pp vs 37.37 -> PASS. Cost $4.43. agent=gpt-5.5-responses reasoning=high, user=gpt-5.2 reasoning=low, max_steps=200.

anchors.rationale: Study-domain (retail) machinery anchor; reproducible with the confirmed gpt-5.2 model (agent=user-sim=gpt-5.2, the board's config). Validates the retail dual-control oracle wiring.

spec.source: Sierra τ²-bench leaderboard submission gpt-5-2_sierra_2026-02-26 full-domain row (results.retail.pass_1=81.58; v0.2.1-dev, user_simulator gpt-5.2). n=114 -> tolerance ~ ±8pp (binomial SE ~ 3.6pp at p=0.8158). Alternative anchor if preferred: retail × claude-opus-4-5 = 79.61 (pending Opus-4.5 API availability).

anchors.measured_run: waggle_ruler_retail_gpt52_high_n114k4 (2026-06-17): pass^1 per-task = 77.70% over 114/114 tasks (435 valid trials, 21 infra-errored). |Δ|=3.88pp vs 81.58 -> PASS. Cost $30.21. agent=user=gpt-5.2 reasoning=high/low, max_steps=200. (First attempt 68.16% was reasoning-OFF + max_steps=30 — see docs/12.)
